description: This source file defines an HttpService class that encapsulates HTTP operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for communicating with a web API, including error handling and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class providing methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON serialization, tailored for use in Blazor applications.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and deserializes the JSON response into a specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request and deserializes the JSON response into a specified type.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with provided data serialized as JSON, handles errors, and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with data serialized as JSON, handles errors, and deserializes the response.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON and wraps it in StringContent for HTTP requests.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes the HTTP response content JSON into a specified object.
